cat << 'EOF' > /work/refine_sofa.py
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import math
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

H = 1.55
def ground_pt(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, cam_yaw_deg):
    d_fwd = H * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    d_right = H * (u - 256.0) / (v - 256.0)
    rad = math.radians(cam_yaw_deg)
    wx = cam_x + d_fwd * math.sin(rad) + d_right * math.cos(rad)
    wy = cam_y + d_fwd * math.cos(rad) - d_right * math.sin(rad)
    return wx, wy, d_fwd, d_right

# Sofa in obs14 (cam: 0, 1.5, yaw=270):
im14 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0014.png'))
m14 = (im14[:,:,0] > 60) & (im14[:,:,0] < 110) & (im14[:,:,1] > 70) & (im14[:,:,1] < 120) & (im14[:,:,2] > 80) & (im14[:,:,2] < 130) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 200)
c14 = np.argwhere(m14)
print("Sofa in obs14: u in [{}, {}], v in [{}, {}]".format(c14[:,1].min(), c14[:,1].max(), c14[:,0].min(), c14[:,0].max()))

# Sofa corners in obs14:
# Left edge (closest):
v14_max = c14[:,0].max()
feet14 = c14[c14[:,0] > v14_max - 5]
u14_min = feet14[:,1].min()
u14_max = feet14[:,1].max()
print("Sofa bottom contact: v={}, u_min={}, u_max={}".format(v14_max, u14_min, u14_max))
p_sofa_corner_left = ground_pt(u14_min, v14_max, 0, 1.5, 270)
p_sofa_corner_right = ground_pt(u14_max, v14_max, 0, 1.5, 270)
print("Sofa front bottom left:", p_sofa_corner_left)
print("Sofa front bottom right:", p_sofa_corner_right)

# In obs18 (cam: 0, 2.0, yaw=270):
im18 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0018.png'))
m18 = (im18[:,:,0] > 60) & (im18[:,:,0] < 110) & (im18[:,:,1] > 70) & (im18[:,:,1] < 120) & (im18[:,:,2] > 80) & (im18[:,:,2] < 130) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 300)
c18 = np.argwhere(m18)
v18_max = c18[:,0].max()
feet18 = c18[c18[:,0] > v18_max - 5]
u18_min = feet18[:,1].min()
p_sofa_18 = ground_pt(u18_min, v18_max, 0, 2.0, 270)
print("Sofa from obs18:", p_sofa_18)

# Center of sofa:
# Left corner is at (-2.36, 2.65), it extends backwards along -x (depth ~0.85m) and along +y (width ~2.0m)
# Let's check sofa back wall / length:
print("Sofa extents estimate: x around -2.75, y around 3.5")
